faqs.question: How do I apply for admission?
alternate_questions: How can I apply?
What is the admission process?
How do I enroll?
Where do I submit my application?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students should complete the online application form on the university admissions portal, upload the required documents (mark sheets, ID proof, category certificate if applicable), participate in counselling if applicable for their program, and pay the admission fee after seat allotment is confirmed. Applicants should keep their application reference number for future correspondence.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission?
alternate_questions: Am I eligible to apply?
What marks do I need for admission?
What are the minimum qualifications required?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Eligibility varies by program. For undergraduate engineering programs, candidates typically need a minimum of 45% aggregate marks in the qualifying examination (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as core subjects, along with a valid entrance exam score. Postgraduate programs require a relevant bachelor's degree with minimum aggregate marks as specified by the department. Students should check the specific program page for exact requirements.

faqs.question: What documents are required for admission?
alternate_questions: Which documents should I upload?
What paperwork do I need for enrollment?
List of documents needed for admission
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Required documents typically include 10th and 12th mark sheets, transfer certificate, migration certificate, category certificate (if applicable), income certificate (for scholarship consideration), Aadhaar card or valid government ID, passport-size photographs, and entrance exam scorecard. All documents should be scanned in PDF format and uploaded during the online application process.

faqs.question: How does the counselling process work?
alternate_questions: What happens during counselling?
How is seat allotment done?
How do I attend counselling for seat selection?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Counselling is conducted in multiple rounds based on entrance exam rank. Candidates must register on the counselling portal, fill their college and branch preferences (choice filling), and wait for seat allotment. Once a seat is allotted, students must confirm acceptance and pay the seat confirmation fee within the specified deadline, or the seat may be released to the next candidate.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for admission?
alternate_questions: When does the application close?
What is the admission deadline?
Is there still time to apply?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Admission application deadlines vary by program and academic session. Typically, undergraduate applications close by the end of June, while postgraduate applications may extend into July. Students should always refer to the official academic calendar for exact dates, as late applications are generally not accepted except in special circumstances approved by the Admissions Committee.

faqs.question: Is lateral entry admission available?
alternate_questions: Can diploma holders get direct second year admission?
What is lateral entry?
How do I apply for lateral entry into engineering?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Lateral entry admission allows diploma holders or B.Sc. graduates to directly join the second year of a relevant engineering program, subject to seat availability and qualifying lateral entry exam scores. Applicants must apply through the lateral entry admission portal and submit diploma mark sheets along with other standard documents.

faqs.question: Can I transfer from another college?
alternate_questions: How do I apply for a college transfer?
Is inter-college transfer allowed?
What is the process for migrating to this university?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Inter-college transfers are permitted only under specific conditions, such as parental transfer or medical grounds, and are subject to seat availability in the desired branch. Students must submit a transfer request along with supporting documents to the Registrar's office, and approval is granted at the discretion of the university administration.

faqs.question: How can I pay my semester fees?
alternate_questions: Can I pay fees online?
What payment methods are accepted?
Is UPI payment available?
Can parents pay fees on my behalf?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Semester fees can be paid online through the student portal using net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI. Parents or guardians may also make the payment on behalf of the student as long as the correct student enrollment number is entered during checkout. A payment receipt is generated instantly and should be downloaded for personal records.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the fee payment deadline?
alternate_questions: What if I pay fees late?
Is there a fine for late fee payment?
Can I still pay fees after the due date?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: If a student misses the fee payment deadline, a late fee penalty is applied, typically calculated per day of delay, up to a maximum grace period defined by the university. Beyond the grace period, the student's semester registration may be put on hold, restricting access to exams and academic services until the outstanding fee is cleared.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for my program?
alternate_questions: How much does tuition cost?
What are the semester fee details?
How much do I need to pay per year?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Fee structure varies by program and category (General, OBC, SC/ST, EWS). It typically includes tuition fee, examination fee, development fee, and miscellaneous charges. A detailed, program-wise fee breakdown is published annually on the Fee Structure page of the university website and may be revised each academic year.

faqs.question: How do I request a fee refund?
alternate_questions: Can I get my admission fee refunded?
What is the refund policy?
I withdrew from the course, will I get my money back?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Fee refunds are processed according to the university's refund policy, which is generally aligned with regulatory guidelines. Refund percentage depends on the date of withdrawal relative to the admission date and the last date of counselling. Students must submit a written refund request through the student portal along with proof of withdrawal.

faqs.question: Can I pay my fees in installments?
alternate_questions: Is there an installment option for fee payment?
Can I split my semester fee into parts?
Does the university allow partial fee payment?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Some programs offer an installment facility for fee payment, allowing students to split the semester fee into two or three parts. This facility must be requested in advance through the Accounts Office and is subject to approval based on the student's financial circumstances and prior payment history.

faqs.question: Am I eligible for a scholarship?
alternate_questions: Who can apply for scholarships?
What are the scholarship eligibility criteria?
Do I qualify for financial aid?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Scholarship eligibility depends on the type of scholarship. Merit-based scholarships require a minimum academic performance threshold (e.g., 75% aggregate or top rank in class), while need-based scholarships require family income below a specified limit along with supporting income certificates. Category-based scholarships (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) require valid category certificates issued by a competent authority.

faqs.question: How do I apply for a scholarship?
alternate_questions: Where do I submit my scholarship application?
What is the process to apply for financial aid?
How can I register on the scholarship portal?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students must register on the state or national scholarship portal (as applicable), fill in personal and academic details, upload required documents such as income and category certificates, and submit the application before the deadline. The university's Scholarship Cell verifies and forwards eligible applications for further processing.

faqs.question: When will I receive my scholarship amount?
alternate_questions: How long does scholarship disbursement take?
When does scholarship money get credited?
Why is my scholarship delayed?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Scholarship disbursement timelines depend on the granting authority (state government, central government, or university-funded schemes) and can range from a few weeks to a few months after verification. Delays are commonly caused by incomplete documentation, bank account mismatches, or pending institutional verification, so students should ensure their bank details are updated and accurate.

faqs.question: Do I need to reapply for my scholarship every year?
alternate_questions: Is scholarship renewal automatic?
How do I renew my scholarship for the next semester?
What is required to continue receiving a scholarship?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Most scholarships require annual renewal. Students must maintain the minimum required academic performance (typically no backlog subjects and minimum attendance) and submit a renewal application with updated income and academic documents each year to continue receiving the benefit.

faqs.question: How do I register for courses each semester?
alternate_questions: How can I enroll in subjects for the new semester?
What is the course registration process?
Where do I select my electives?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Course registration is done through the academic portal at the start of each semester. Students select core and elective subjects based on their curriculum, subject to seat availability for electives. Registration must be completed before the deadline; late registration may require departmental approval and could involve a late registration fee.

faqs.question: What is the minimum attendance required?
alternate_questions: How much attendance do I need to sit for exams?
What happens if my attendance is low?
Is there a condonation for shortage of attendance?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students are generally required to maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each subject to be eligible to appear for end-semester examinations. In genuine cases such as medical emergencies, students may apply for attendance condonation with supporting documents, subject to approval by the Dean of Academics, though attendance may not be condoned below 65%.

faqs.question: How does the grading system work?
alternate_questions: What is the CGPA calculation method?
How are grades assigned in each subject?
What is the difference between SGPA and CGPA?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The university follows a 10-point relative or absolute grading system depending on the program. Each subject is awarded a letter grade based on internal assessment and end-semester examination performance, converted to grade points. SGPA (Semester Grade Point Average) reflects performance in a single semester, while CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) reflects overall performance across all completed semesters.

faqs.question: How do I clear a backlog subject?
alternate_questions: What if I fail a subject?
How can I reappear for a failed paper?
What is the process for backlog exams?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students who fail a subject (commonly called a backlog) can reappear in the subsequent back-paper or improvement examination, typically conducted at the end of the next semester or during a dedicated back-exam window. Students must register for the backlog exam through the academic portal and pay the applicable examination fee.

faqs.question: Can I change my branch after first year?
alternate_questions: How do I request a branch change?
Is inter-branch transfer allowed?
What is the process to switch my engineering branch?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Branch change requests are generally considered at the end of the first year, based on the student's academic performance (CGPA) and seat availability in the desired branch. Students must submit a formal application to the Academic Office within the specified window, and final approval is at the discretion of the university's Academic Committee.

faqs.question: Where can I find my course syllabus?
alternate_questions: How do I access the curriculum for my branch?
Where is the subject syllabus published?
Can I download the semester-wise syllabus?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The complete semester-wise syllabus and curriculum for each branch is published on the university's academic resources page and can be downloaded as a PDF. Students should refer to the syllabus version corresponding to their admission year, as curriculum revisions may apply to newer batches.

faqs.question: When will the end-semester exams be held?
alternate_questions: What is the exam timetable?
When does the exam schedule get released?
How do I check my exam dates?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The end-semester examination schedule is published on the university's examination portal typically two to three weeks before exams commence. Students should regularly check the portal or notice board for updates, as exam dates and seating arrangements may be revised due to unforeseen circumstances.

faqs.question: How do I download my admit card?
alternate_questions: Where can I get my exam hall ticket?
How to print exam admit card?
My admit card is not generating, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Admit cards are generated on the examination portal once fee payment and attendance requirements are verified as complete. Students can log in with their enrollment number to download and print the admit card. If the admit card does not generate, it usually indicates a pending fee dues or attendance shortfall, and students should contact the Examination Cell immediately.

faqs.question: When will my exam results be declared?
alternate_questions: How do I check my semester result?
Where can I view my marksheet?
Why is my result not showing on the portal?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Semester results are typically declared within four to six weeks after the completion of end-semester examinations and are published on the results portal. If a result is withheld, it is usually due to pending dues, unresolved malpractice cases, or incomplete internal assessment submissions, and students should reach out to the Examination Cell for clarification.

faqs.question: How do I apply for revaluation of my answer sheet?
alternate_questions: Can I request rechecking of my exam paper?
What is the process for grade improvement?
How much does revaluation cost?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students who wish to have their answer sheet re-evaluated must submit a revaluation request through the examination portal within the specified window after result declaration, along with the applicable revaluation fee per subject. Revaluation typically involves rechecking of totals and verification that all answers were graded, and results are usually announced within two to three weeks.

faqs.question: What happens if I am caught using unfair means in an exam?
alternate_questions: What is the penalty for cheating during exams?
What counts as malpractice in exams?
Can I appeal an unfair means case?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Use of unfair means during an examination, including possession of unauthorized material or impersonation, is treated seriously. Depending on the severity, penalties range from cancellation of the specific paper to debarment from examinations for one or more semesters. Students found guilty may appeal to the Unfair Means Committee within the specified timeframe.

faqs.question: When does the new semester start?
alternate_questions: What is the semester start date?
When do classes begin?
When does this semester end?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The odd semester typically begins in July/August and ends in December, while the even semester begins in January and ends in May/June. Exact dates are published in the official Academic Calendar at the start of each academic year and may be adjusted for holidays or special events.

faqs.question: What are the university holidays this year?
alternate_questions: Is there a holiday list available?
When is the winter break?
How many holidays do we get in a semester?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The university publishes an annual holiday list covering national holidays, festival breaks, winter break, and summer break. This list is available on the Academic Calendar page and may be updated periodically to reflect regional or state-specific holidays.

faqs.question: When is the convocation ceremony?
alternate_questions: When will I receive my degree?
How do I register for convocation?
What is the process to attend graduation ceremony?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Convocation ceremonies are usually held once a year, typically towards the end of the calendar year, for students who have successfully completed all degree requirements. Eligible students must register for convocation through the university portal and pay the convocation fee to receive their degree certificate on the ceremony day.

faqs.question: How do I apply for hostel accommodation?
alternate_questions: How can I get a hostel room?
What is the process for hostel allotment?
Where do I submit my hostel application?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students seeking hostel accommodation must apply through the hostel portal after admission confirmation, indicating room type preference (single/double/triple sharing). Allotment is based on availability, distance from home, and in some cases merit or first-come-first-served basis. Students must pay the hostel fee within the deadline to confirm their allotment.

faqs.question: What are the hostel fees?
alternate_questions: How much does hostel accommodation cost?
Is mess fee included in hostel fee?
What is the annual hostel charge?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Hostel fees typically include room rent, mess charges, electricity/water charges, and a refundable security deposit. Fees vary based on room type (single, double, or triple occupancy) and are payable annually or semester-wise as specified by the Hostel Office.

faqs.question: What are the hostel rules and curfew timings?
alternate_questions: What time is hostel curfew?
Are outside guests allowed in the hostel?
What is the hostel code of conduct?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Hostel residents are expected to follow the code of conduct, including a curfew time (commonly 9:30 PM to 10:00 PM on weekdays), restrictions on outside guests, and prohibition of items like electric heaters or unauthorized appliances. Repeated violations may lead to disciplinary action, including possible expulsion from the hostel.

faqs.question: How do I apply for hostel leave?
alternate_questions: How do I request an outpass?
Can I stay out overnight from the hostel?
What is the process to leave hostel for the weekend?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students must apply for an outpass through the hostel warden's office or online portal, specifying the reason and duration of leave. Overnight or outstation leave typically requires parental consent, especially for first-year students, and must be approved before departure from the hostel premises.

faqs.question: How do I get a library membership?
alternate_questions: How can I get a library card?
Is library access automatic for students?
How do I register for library services?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: All enrolled students are automatically granted library membership upon admission, linked to their student ID card. Students can use their ID card to borrow books, access digital resources, and use reading rooms. Lost ID cards should be reported immediately to avoid misuse.

faqs.question: How many books can I borrow at a time?
alternate_questions: What is the book issue limit?
How long can I keep a borrowed book?
Can postgraduate students borrow more books than undergraduates?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Undergraduate students can typically borrow up to 3 books at a time for a loan period of 14 days, while postgraduate and research students may be allowed up to 5 books for a 21-day period. Loan periods may be extended through renewal if the book is not on hold by another student.

faqs.question: What is the fine for late return of library books?
alternate_questions: How much do I pay if I return a book late?
Is there a penalty for overdue books?
How can I clear my library dues?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: A late return fine is charged per day per book beyond the due date, as specified in the library policy. Students with unpaid library fines may face restrictions on borrowing further books, and pending fines must be cleared before receiving semester results or the No Dues Certificate.

faqs.question: Does the library provide access to e-books and journals?
alternate_questions: How do I access online journals?
Is there a digital library?
Can I read e-books from home?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The library provides access to a digital repository of e-books, research journals, and academic databases, accessible both on-campus and remotely through the university's VPN or digital library portal using student credentials. Students should contact the library helpdesk for login issues.

faqs.question: How do I contact the Admissions Office?
alternate_questions: What is the phone number for admissions?
How do I email the admissions team?
Where is the admissions office located?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The Admissions Office can be reached at admissions@sampleuniversity.edu (Sample Data) or via phone at +91-XXXXXXXXXX during working hours (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM). The office is located in the Administrative Block, Room 101, on the main campus.

faqs.question: How do I contact the Examination Cell?
alternate_questions: What is the examination department's helpline?
Where can I raise an exam-related query?
How do I email the exam controller?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The Examination Cell can be contacted at examcell@sampleuniversity.edu (Sample Data) or via the helpline number displayed on the examination portal. The office is located in the Administrative Block, Room 205, and is open on working days from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

faqs.question: How do I contact the Hostel Office?
alternate_questions: What is the hostel warden's contact number?
How do I reach the hostel administration?
Where is the hostel office located?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The Hostel Office can be contacted at hostel@sampleuniversity.edu (Sample Data) or through the respective hostel warden, whose contact details are displayed on the hostel notice board. The central hostel administration office is located near Hostel Block A.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for IT or portal issues?
alternate_questions: My student portal login isn't working, who can help?
How do I reach IT support?
Is there a helpdesk for technical issues?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: For technical issues related to the student portal, email login, or Wi-Fi access, students can contact the IT Helpdesk at ithelpdesk@sampleuniversity.edu (Sample Data) or visit the IT Services counter in the Computer Center building during working hours.

faqs.question: What is the student code of conduct?
alternate_questions: What behavior is expected from students?
What are the disciplinary policies?
What actions can lead to disciplinary action?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students are expected to maintain discipline, respect fellow students and staff, and refrain from activities such as ragging, harassment, or damage to university property. Violations are addressed through the university's Disciplinary Committee, and penalties range from warnings to suspension or expulsion, depending on severity.

faqs.question: What is the anti-ragging policy?
alternate_questions: How do I report ragging?
Is ragging punishable?
What should I do if I witness ragging?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The university maintains a strict zero-tolerance anti-ragging policy in compliance with regulatory guidelines. Any incident of ragging can be reported anonymously through the anti-ragging helpline or committee, and confirmed cases result in severe disciplinary action, including potential expulsion and reporting to law enforcement authorities.

faqs.question: How do I file a grievance or complaint?
alternate_questions: Where can I submit a student complaint?
Is there a grievance redressal committee?
How do I escalate an unresolved issue?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students can file grievances related to academics, administration, or personal issues through the Grievance Redressal Portal or by submitting a written complaint to the Grievance Redressal Committee. Complaints are typically reviewed and responded to within 15 working days, with escalation paths available for unresolved matters.

faqs.question: How do I apply for a leave of absence from the university?
alternate_questions: Can I take a semester break?
What is the process for academic leave?
How do I apply for a gap year?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students seeking a leave of absence for medical, personal, or other valid reasons must submit a formal application to the Dean of Academics along with supporting documents. Approved leave allows students to rejoin in a subsequent academic session without losing their seat, subject to university policy on maximum permissible duration of absence.

faqs.question: How do I get a replacement student ID card?
alternate_questions: I lost my ID card, what should I do?
How can I request a duplicate ID card?
What is the fee for a new ID card?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: In case of a lost or damaged ID card, students should first file a report with campus security and then submit a duplicate ID card request through the Student Affairs Office, along with the applicable replacement fee. The new ID card is typically issued within 5-7 working days.

faqs.question: How do I obtain a No Dues Certificate?
alternate_questions: What is required to get clearance from the university?
How do I clear all my dues before graduating?
Where do I get the no dues form signed?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: A No Dues Certificate confirms that a student has cleared all fee, library, hostel, and department dues. Students must fill out a no-dues form and obtain signatures from respective departments (Accounts, Library, Hostel, and Academic Department) before it can be submitted to the Registrar's Office for final clearance, typically required before receiving the final degree or transcripts.

faqs.question: How do I log in to the student portal?
alternate_questions: What is my student portal username?
I forgot my portal password, how do I reset it?
Where do I access the student dashboard?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students can log in to the student portal using the enrollment number as the username and the password set during registration. If the password is forgotten, it can be reset using the 'Forgot Password' link, which sends a reset code to the registered email or mobile number.

faqs.question: How do I connect to campus Wi-Fi?
alternate_questions: What is the Wi-Fi password on campus?
How do I get internet access in the hostel?
Why is campus Wi-Fi not connecting?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Campus Wi-Fi access is provided to all enrolled students using their student portal credentials for authentication. If connection issues persist, students should verify their device network settings or contact the IT Helpdesk located at the Computer Center for troubleshooting assistance.

faqs.question: How is internal assessment calculated?
alternate_questions: What is included in internal marks?
How much weightage do internals carry?
How are sessional marks awarded?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Internal assessment typically comprises class tests, assignments, quizzes, attendance, and classroom participation, together accounting for around 25-30% of the total marks in a subject, while the remaining weightage comes from the end-semester examination. Exact weightage may vary by department and subject type (theory vs. practical).

faqs.question: What is the process for final year project submission?
alternate_questions: How do I submit my major project?
What is the deadline for project report submission?
Do I need a project guide's approval before submission?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Final year project submission requires students to complete their project under an assigned guide, prepare a formatted report following university guidelines, and submit both a hard copy and digital copy before the deadline specified in the academic calendar. Approval from the project guide and department coordinator is mandatory before submission is accepted.

faqs.question: Can I get academic credit for an internship?
alternate_questions: Does the university recognize internships for credit?
How do I get my internship approved?
What documents are needed for internship credit?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students can earn academic credit for internships completed with approved organizations, provided the internship is pre-approved by the department coordinator and meets the minimum duration requirement (commonly 4-6 weeks). Students must submit an internship report, certificate, and supervisor evaluation to receive credit.

faqs.question: How do I get an official academic transcript?
alternate_questions: How can I request my transcript for higher studies?
What is the process to get a consolidated marksheet?
How long does it take to get a transcript?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Official transcripts can be requested through the Registrar's Office by submitting an online request along with the applicable fee. Processing typically takes 7-10 working days, and transcripts may be issued as physical copies, digitally verified PDFs, or sent directly to foreign universities upon request for higher studies applications.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for campus placements?
alternate_questions: Who can sit for placement drives?
Do I need a minimum CGPA for placements?
Is there a backlog restriction for placement eligibility?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Placement eligibility generally requires students to maintain a minimum CGPA (commonly 6.0 to 6.5 on a 10-point scale) with no active backlogs at the time of the placement drive. Specific companies may set additional criteria such as branch restrictions or minimum percentage in 10th/12th, which are communicated by the Placement Cell before each drive.

faqs.question: How do I register for campus placements?
alternate_questions: Where do I sign up for placement drives?
How do I update my resume on the placement portal?
How do I get notified about upcoming companies?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Students must register on the university's Placement Portal by uploading an updated resume, academic transcripts, and personal details. Once registered, students receive notifications about upcoming company drives and can apply for specific opportunities based on their eligibility.

faqs.question: Does the university provide placement training?
alternate_questions: Is there aptitude test preparation available?
Are mock interviews conducted before placements?
How can I improve my soft skills for interviews?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The Placement Cell conducts pre-placement training sessions covering aptitude tests, group discussions, mock interviews, and soft skills development, typically starting in the pre-final year. Students are encouraged to attend these sessions to improve their readiness for campus recruitment drives.

faqs.question: How do I get a bonafide certificate?
alternate_questions: Where can I request a student status certificate?
How long does it take to issue a bonafide certificate?
Do I need a bonafide certificate for a bank loan?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: A bonafide certificate, confirming active enrollment status, can be requested through the Student Affairs Office or the online student portal. It is commonly required for bank loans, passport applications, or visa processing, and is usually issued within 3-5 working days of the request.

faqs.question: What documents do I need for an education loan application?
alternate_questions: How do I get fee estimate documents for a bank loan?
Can the university help with loan paperwork?
What certificate do banks ask for education loans?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: For education loan applications, students typically need an admission letter, fee structure/estimate certificate, and bonafide certificate, all of which can be obtained from the Accounts Office and Student Affairs Office. Some banks may also request academic performance records for loan disbursement in subsequent years.

faqs.question: Is there a medical facility on campus?
alternate_questions: Where is the campus health center?
What should I do in a medical emergency on campus?
Is there a doctor available in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The university operates an on-campus health center staffed with a resident doctor and nursing staff for basic medical care and emergencies, generally available during working hours with on-call support for hostel residents after hours. Serious medical emergencies are referred to nearby partner hospitals for advanced treatment.

faqs.question: What sports facilities are available on campus?
alternate_questions: Is there a gym on campus?
How do I join the university cricket team?
What indoor games are available in the hostel?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The campus offers sports facilities including a gymnasium, outdoor grounds for cricket, football, and athletics, plus indoor facilities for badminton, table tennis, and chess. Students interested in representing the university at inter-college tournaments can register with the Sports Department during the trials conducted each semester.

faqs.question: How do I join a student club or society?
alternate_questions: What clubs are available for students?
How do I start a new student club?
Is there a technical club for coding enthusiasts?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: The university hosts various student-run clubs including technical, cultural, literary, and social service societies. Students can join by registering during the club recruitment drive typically held at the start of each academic year, and new clubs can be proposed by submitting a formal proposal to the Student Activities Committee.

faqs.question: What is a supplementary examination?
alternate_questions: Is there a special exam for students who missed the main exam?
How do I apply for a supplementary exam?
When are supplementary exams conducted?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: A supplementary examination is conducted for students who were unable to appear for the regular end-semester exam due to valid reasons such as medical emergencies, with prior approval from the Dean of Academics. These are typically scheduled shortly after the regular exam results are declared, subject to submission of supporting documents.

faqs.question: How are practical/lab exams conducted?
alternate_questions: What is the format of lab exams?
Who evaluates practical exams?
Do I need a lab record for practical exams?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Practical/lab examinations are typically conducted by an internal faculty member along with an external examiner appointed by the university. Students must submit a completed and signed lab record/journal at the time of the exam, and evaluation is based on viva-voce, practical performance, and the lab record.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is required for admission?
alternate_questions: Do I need JEE or a state-level exam for admission?
What entrance exams does the university accept?
Is there a direct admission option without an entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Sample Data: Admission to undergraduate engineering programs is typically based on a state-level entrance examination or JEE Main scores, depending on the program and category. Some management or self-financed seats may be available through direct admission, subject to eligibility criteria and seat availability. Postgraduate admissions often require GATE or an equivalent university entrance test scores.

faqs.question: Is there a management quota for admission?

faqs.question: Will my scholarship be adjusted against my fee automatically?

faqs.question: What is the caution money deposit and is it refundable?

How do I claim my refundable deposit?

This deposit is refundable after graduation, provided there are no outstanding dues, and can be claimed by submitting a refund request along with the No Dues Certificate to the Accounts Office.

faqs.question: Does the university offer merit scholarships for top scorers?
alternate_questions: Is there a scholarship for toppers?
How is merit scholarship amount decided?
Do I need to apply separately for merit scholarship?

faqs.question: Is there a scholarship for sports achievements?

Are exchange program credits transferable?
